annexes.title: Individual Jupyter Notebooks
annexes.description: The following Jupyter notebooks contain the complete implementation code, data analysis, and experimental results for each student's investigation. These notebooks are submitted as separate files accompanying this report.

items.label: Annex A.1
items.title: Student 1: Ensemble Methods Notebook
items.description: Complete implementation of BaggingClassifier investigation including baseline comparison, hyperparameter optimization, and bias-variance decomposition analysis.

items.label: Annex A.2
items.title: Student 2: Non-Linear Methods Notebook
items.description: Complete implementation of DecisionTreeClassifier investigation including baseline comparison, hyperparameter optimization, and bias-variance decomposition analysis.

items.label: Annex A.3
items.title: Student 3: Support Vector Methods Notebook
items.description: Complete implementation of RidgeClassifier investigation including baseline comparison, hyperparameter optimization, and bias-variance decomposition analysis.

annexes.title: Dataset Information
annexes.description: The NSL-KDD dataset used in this study is publicly available from the Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity.
